fees.label: Development Services / trade permit — confirm Fort Worth schedule
fees.citation_note: Amount requires live Fort Worth fee schedule. Do not invent dollars.

gotchas.title: Fee schedule is not a fixed number — recheck before bid
checklist: Pull current Fort Worth Development Services fee schedule
Do not invent dollar amounts from memory
anti_patterns: Copying Dallas min trade fee into a Fort Worth bid

gotchas.title: ERCOT / TDSP large-load timing
checklist: Treat ERCOT/TDSP interconnection as parallel to City of Fort Worth permits
Schedule contingency early for industrial / data-center load
anti_patterns: Assuming city permit alone clears large-load path

gotchas.title: Confirm trade application type early
checklist: Verify electrical vs general building path with Development Services
anti_patterns: Wrong application type that stalls review
